facts.text: Andaz Shenzhen Bay is a design and boutique hotel conceived as a private clubhouse for the city's elite and world talent.
facts.excerpt: our design & boutique hotel conceived as a private clubhouse for the city’s elite and world talent

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by leading tech companies, multinational firms and the landmark China Resources Building.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by leading tech companies, multinational firms and the landmark China Resources Building

facts.text: The hotel is at 2600 Keyuan South Road in Shenzhen's Nanshan District.
facts.excerpt: 2600 Keyuan South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, 518052 China

facts.text: Rooms are locally inspired and modern, with views of Shenzhen Bay MixC, Shenzhen Talent Park and the Bay.
facts.excerpt: enjoy locally inspired, modern rooms with uninterrupted views of Shenzhen Bay MixC, Shenzhen Talent Park and the Bay

facts.text: The hotel's facilities include a pool.
facts.excerpt: remarkable facilities including five restaurants and bars and a pool

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and rain shower.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows with dramatic views across Shenzhen Bay that will take your breath away. This elegant space in the heart of Nanshan features a plush king bed and a stylish marble bathroom with deep-soaking tub and rain shower

facts.text: Rooms include a complimentary minibar with Andaz IPA beer.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar, including Andaz IPA beer

facts.text: Rooms feature the Byredo Eleventh Hour amenity collection, curated exclusively for Andaz.
facts.excerpt: Byredo Eleventh Hour amenity collection, exclusively curated for Andaz

facts.text: Rooms have a Dyson hair dryer and a Nespresso coffee maker.
facts.excerpt:
Dyson hair dryer
  - Robes and slippers
  - Nespresso coffee maker and tea-making facilities

facts.text: Suites come with Frette tailormade bedding and bath linens.
facts.excerpt: Frette tailormade bedding and bath

facts.text: The Premium Suite has a king bedroom, a separate living room and a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: The luxe space features a king bedroom, separate living room and modern marble bathroom complete with a deep-soaking tub.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a separate living room, a recreation room and a second bathroom, with views across Shenzhen Bay.
facts.excerpt: Luxuriate in this incredible suite designed for relaxing and entertaining with dramatic views across Shenzhen Bay. Features include a plush king bed, separate living room, recreation room, second bathroom

facts.text: Club House East Room serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Club House · East Room is a sensory delight, where guests can savor authentic Cantonese cuisine

facts.text: Club House East Room is decorated with hand-painted de Gournay wallpaper in Chinese-inspired designs.
facts.excerpt: The room’s ambiance is elevated by the hand-painted wallpaper, with de Gournay’s Chinese-inspired designs

facts.text: Club House West Room is a classic modern steakhouse with birchwood maps of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and the South China Sea on its walls.
facts.excerpt: a classic modern steakhouse, is a haven for meat enthusiasts. It creates a space for memories, with birchwood maps adorning the walls, depicting the historical landscapes of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and the South China Sea

facts.text: Club House has an outdoor garden terrace with sea views of the bay area and skyline, facing sunrise in the east and sunset in the west.
facts.excerpt: offering guests and outdoor garden terrace where they can enjoy the sea views of the bay area and skyline, witness the sunrise in the east and bask in the sunset in the west

facts.text: MayGarden is a traditional tea house named after the flame trees that bloom around the hotel's entrance in May.
facts.excerpt: Named after the flame tree with flowers blooming around the hotel’s entrance in May, MayGarden serves as a connective space and traditional tea house for the neighborhood

facts.text: Bar 1919 serves whiskies, wines and signature cocktails to live jazz singers.
facts.excerpt: guests can savor the rich complexity of whiskies from various regions, wines from both old and new world vineyards and signature cocktails by skilled mixologists. All this unfolds to the soothing melodies of jazz singers

facts.text: The hotel has a Wellness Club.
facts.excerpt: Wellness Club

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center

facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour indoor parking area with direct access to the hotel, complimentary for overnight guests.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Shenzhen Bay houses a 24-hour indoor parking area with direct access to the hotel. Complimentary parking is available for overnight guests.

facts.text: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is 26 kilometers away, roughly 35 minutes by taxi.
facts.excerpt: The 26-kilometer journey to Andaz Shenzhen Bay should take roughly 35 minutes

facts.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

facts.text: Pets are not permitted at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted at the hotel.

facts.excerpt: With two elegant ballrooms and an array of customized packages to choose from
